name: ANGELES//2099 shot plan
rule: Cuts land on bar lines from the cue sheet. Inside a shot, camera accents land on beats; the car's suspension and hover emitters answer the kick, snare, 808 and fx drivers. Both candidates share the 10-bar form (hook 1-2, pocket 3-4, build 5, transition 6, drop 7-8, out 9-10), so this plan fits either; the transition shot has a variant per candidate.
lens: 35 mm-equivalent full frame unless noted; shallow depth of field only in the macro shot

shots.name: Ground-scraping reveal
shots.camera: lens 24 mm at 0.18 m above the asphalt, starting on the front-left tiny chrome wheel and hover ring, dollying back along the flank to the full car by bar 2
shots.sync: f0 lead whoop: hover ring flares; every kick: body bounce; f60 (bar 2): emitter colour shifts to warm gold with the talkbox shrink

shots.name: Low tracking through the sweeper
shots.camera: lens 35 mm, 0.6 m high, tracking alongside at the car's speed, slight lag; the city glows below the guardrail
shots.sync: the car drifts 12 degrees into the curve on bar 3; hydraulic hop on the fx 'hop' frame (crest) / Beast answers pulse the underglow (hover)

shots.name: Orbit
shots.camera: orbit 150 degrees around the car, rising from 1 m to 3 m, lens 28 mm
shots.sync: orbit speed eases in to bar 6

shots.name: Into the mouth (CREST)
shots.camera: push straight into the front hover intake as the beat is swallowed; black from the silence (f345) until the slam
shots.sync: the intake's glow closes with the vocal tract (ah, oo, mm); black frames 345-359; the reversed breath brings up a faint violet rim

shots.name: Spin-up (HOVER)
shots.camera: static low three-quarter; the car rises 0.6 m on its rings while the rings accelerate from visible pulses to a continuous glow
shots.sync: ring pulse rate follows the spin-up (pulses at f240, fused by ~f310); everything holds still in the eighth of silence (f352-359)

shots.name: Crane reveal of the megacity
shots.camera: on the slam the camera is at bumper height; it cranes up and back over the guardrail, 3 m to 40 m, revealing the basin, downtown megatowers, blimps and the grid
shots.sync: f360 slam: all four corners drop, dust and a violet shock ring on the asphalt; kicks keep the car breathing

shots.name: Hero drift
shots.camera: long lens 85 mm from the next curve: the car slides sideways through the hairpin, the city behind it; the last 12 frames return toward S1's wheel framing so the loop closes
shots.sync: hop on the final fx frame (crest) / the tape-stop dive lowers the car (hover)

styleframes.name: Angeles Crest
